comment.author: gulfco
comment.body_excerpt: Follow-up: the owner restarted the gateway service (systemctl --user restart openclaw-gateway) at ~14:43 local. The malformed empty user_r ... isted session state (SQLite) or the signal-cli delivery queue — rather than in-memory gateway state. A service restart does not clear it.

reasons: On-topic debugging follow-up documenting a service restart, repeated event delivery, and potential persistence causes.
No solicitation, unrelated promotion, phishing, or abuse.
